description: This file defines classes for parsing, evaluating, and managing formulas in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes the FormulaNode class for representing expression trees and the FormulaCalculator class for evaluating formulas, handling functions, variables, counters, and date manipulations.

classes.name: FormulaNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a formula expression tree, containing text, level, parent, children, and evaluated value.

classes.name: FormulaCalculator
classes.description: Evaluates formulas with support for functions, variables, counters, and date manipulations within SuiteCRM, with integrated debugging capabilities.

methods.name: calculateFormula
methods.description: Public method that evaluates a formula string and returns its computed value.

methods.name: createTree
methods.description: Builds an expression tree from a formula string.

methods.name: findLexicalElementsOnLevel
methods.description: Recursively finds and adds sub-expressions at a given level of the formula.

methods.name: evaluateTreeLevel
methods.description: Recursively evaluates an expression tree.

methods.name: evaluateNode
methods.description: Evaluates a node, executing functions or returning raw values.

methods.name: evaluateLeaf
methods.description: Replaces parameter placeholders with actual parameter values.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariables
methods.description: Replaces global variable placeholders with their evaluated values.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariable
methods.description: Handles replacement and updating of individual global variables with persistence.

methods.name: getGlobalVariableConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current counter values for global variables, considering their context and date.

methods.name: setGlobalVariableConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration with new counter values for global variables.

methods.name: formatCounter
methods.description: Formats counters with leading zeros.

methods.name: evaluateFunctionParams
methods.description: Parses and resolves function parameters within the formula.

methods.name: getFunctionParameters
methods.description: Extracts parameter list from a function call in the formula.

methods.name: getParameterArray
methods.description: Splits parameter string into individual parameters, handling nested expressions.

methods.name: getParameterText
methods.description: Extracts the raw parameter text from a function call.

methods.name: parseFloat
methods.description: Converts string to float, handling comma as decimal separator.

methods.name: modifyDate
methods.description: Adjusts a date or datetime string by adding or subtracting specified intervals.

methods.name: evaluateLeaf
methods.description: Substitutes parameter placeholders with actual parameter values or global variables.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs debug messages if enabled.

methods.name: logVardump
methods.description: Logs detailed variable dumps for debugging.

methods.name: getDBFormat
methods.description: Converts date strings to database format, considering context and timezone.
